label: Local correction caps
title: Finite correction caps exist, but local coordinates have a cost
summary: An all-ECA full-shift census retains1,094 exact cap budgets and3,514 conflicts. Rule32 has a compact nonconstant two-row closure; correction and observation coordinates have different local costs.
takeaway: Finite correction closure is possible without retaining the source, but extra rows need not simplify the cap and closure is not automatically compression.
